Insured Home Renovation Georgia

You can get a free, written, and itemized quote for your home renovation project from Build Heritage, a licensed and insured contractor in Georgia. Build Heritage offers 8 trades to help you with your project, and you can expect a response within one business day.

How Insured Home Renovation Works in Georgia

Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including Packing & Moving, Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, and Roofing & Tiles. You can get a quote by filling out the quote form or contacting info@buildheritage.org.

What You Get and What It Costs

The cost of a home renovation project in Georgia can vary. Build Heritage provides a cost guide to help you estimate the costs. For example, a full roof replacement can cost between $9,000-$20,000, and a whole-home interior repaint can cost between $3,000-$8,000. It's also recommended to hold back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, including areas like Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, Columbus. How do I get a quote? You can get a quote by filling out the quote form or contacting info@buildheritage.org. Are you licensed and insured? Yes, Build Heritage is licensed and insured in Georgia.

To get started with your insured home renovation project in Georgia, get a free quote from Build Heritage
